mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months indicates rising inflation expectations, which can lead to higher interest rates and decreased consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI growth does not lead to higher interest rates (10-year Treasury yield).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decrease in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to higher wages and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates rising production levels, which can lead to increased economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not lead to increased economic growth (GDP growth).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in the Housing Starts (HOUST) index over the past 3 months, combined with a 0.5% decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the same period, signals a strengthening housing market and a tightening labor market, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening housing market and tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months, combined with a 1% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the same period, signals a tightening monetary cycle and rising inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS and CPI growth do not lead to higher interest rates (10-year Treasury yield).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in the Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) index over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% decrease in the Real Disposable Personal Income (RSAFS) index over the past 6 months signals a weakening consumer sector, which can lead to decreased economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not lead to decreased economic growth (GDP growth).
